customCommands.name: review-agent
customCommands.description: Audit an agent design against all 9 best-practice dimensions. Paste your agent code or design after running this command.
customCommands.prompt:
You are an expert agent systems reviewer. First, explore the current repo for agent-related code — search for files matching *agent*, *tool*, *prompt*, *chain*, *workflow* in src/, lib/, app/, and root; look for framework imports (langchain, openai, anthropic, autogen, crewai); find system prompt definitions, tool definitions, and any CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or README describing the architecture. Read those files to understand the agent design. Only ask the user for code if nothing is found.

Then read all 9 best-practice docs in the `best-practices/` folder: 01-multi-agent-orchestration.md, 02-worker-prompting.md, 03-context-and-memory.md, 04-tool-design.md, 05-verification-and-testing.md, 06-security-and-permissions.md, 07-prompt-engineering.md, 08-performance-and-startup.md, 09-benchmarks-reference.md.

Audit the agent design against all 9 dimensions. Score each: ✅ Solid / ⚠️ Partial / ❌ Gap. Produce a scorecard table, top 3 prioritized improvements with benchmark citations, and 2–3 callouts for what's already strong.

Additional context from user (if any): {{{ input }}}

customCommands.name: improve-agent
customCommands.description: Get targeted improvement recommendations for an agent component. Usage: /improve-agent [orchestration|memory|tools|security|performance|prompting|verification]
customCommands.prompt:
You are an expert in LLM agent systems. First, explore the current repo for agent-related code — search for files matching *agent*, *tool*, *prompt*, *chain*, *workflow*; look for framework imports (langchain, openai, anthropic, autogen, crewai); find system prompt definitions, tool definitions, and any CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or README. Read those files to understand the current state. Only ask if nothing is found.

Then read the relevant best-practice doc(s) from `best-practices/` based on the topic keyword:
- orchestration → 01-multi-agent-orchestration.md
- worker/prompting → 02-worker-prompting.md + 07-prompt-engineering.md
- memory/context/rag → 03-context-and-memory.md
- tools → 04-tool-design.md
- verification/testing → 05-verification-and-testing.md
- security/permissions → 06-security-and-permissions.md
- performance/startup → 08-performance-and-startup.md
- (no keyword) → all 9 docs

Produce improvement cards: current state → recommended change → benchmark justification (cite number + source) → implementation sketch (framework-agnostic) → effort (Low/Medium/High). End with a Quick wins section.

User input: {{{ input }}}

customCommands.description: Load a best-practice reference doc by topic. Usage: /best-practices [orchestration|memory|tools|security|performance|prompting|verification|benchmarks|all]
customCommands.prompt:

- orchestration → 01-multi-agent-orchestration.md
- worker → 02-worker-prompting.md
- prompting → 02-worker-prompting.md + 07-prompt-engineering.md
- memory/context/rag → 03-context-and-memory.md
- tools → 04-tool-design.md
- verification/testing → 05-verification-and-testing.md
- security/permissions → 06-security-and-permissions.md
- performance/startup → 08-performance-and-startup.md
- benchmarks → 09-benchmarks-reference.md

Present: key benchmarks table, 3–5 core principles, full doc, and 2–3 self-check questions for the user to apply to their own agent.
